span.p:
Sets effort variables + product definition (Q&A)
Answers the human queue - owns ceilings, scope, policy

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Engineering Manager / Delivery Lead
= Maestro (the session)
dispatch - capacity - merge authority - process

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Program / PMO Analyst + Metrics
= Foreman + Courier + the Wall
status - integrity - throughput/cost metrics -
capacity recommendations - reporting

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Solution / Enterprise Architect
= Architect
domain design - requirements sign-off - rulings -
arcs and stories authored from the design

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Governance / Standards Board
= Adjudicator
tie-breaks - decision conflicts - trade-off rulings

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Business / Technical Analysts
= Researchers (N, parallel)
investigation - evidence with sources -
options with costs - never code

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Engineers
= Builders (N, parallel, leased scopes)
implementation + owed tests + mutation evidence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Release Engineer
= Integrator (hat)
rebase - safety proof - gates LAST - one PR at a time

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
QA / Code Review
= Reviewer (cold read) + external lanes +
testing standards + mutation protocol + DoD gate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Security/Compliance Authority
= Warden (exactly one)
guardrail corpus - architecture sign-off -
data-use verdicts - delivery audit
blocks autonomously, never grants

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The cross-cutting lane:
SAST + secrets - network-gated research -
localhost-only surfaces - consent-gated installs

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Backlog + board = arcs / stories / bugs on the Wall
SLA ladder - escalation - grooming by integrity sweep -
decision log DEC-NNNN
